summary: Bluerock Homes Trust filed an 8-K reporting the completed disposition of 35 single-family residential units from its Golden Pacific joint venture (in which it held a 97% interest) to unaffiliated third parties. The aggregate sales price was approximately $9.0 million, netting $8.1 million after closing costs and adjustments. The board did not issue a recommendation; the transactions were executed under multiple purchase and sale agreements over January–May 2026. No regulatory clock or structural complexities were noted. Watch for further portfolio streamlining and potential impact on the company's REIT asset composition.
